campaigns.name: Foundry Moon
campaigns.summary: The Separatists have restarted the droid foundry on Ordo Kessa, a mining moon the Republic thought was worked out. Every few weeks a frigate lifts from its landing field with a battalion of new battle droids. A clone company and its Jedi commander have one window before the next shipment leaves: blind the moon's defence grid, break the droids' command, and stop the ship.

mission.title: Foundry Moon 1: Lights Out at Refinery Nine
mission.situation: Refinery Nine is the outermost station of the droid foundry on Ordo Kessa. Its two uplink masts tie it into the defence grid that guards the landing fields. A B1 section stands watch at the west mast; more droids work the yards. Knock both masts out before dawn and the gunships can land.

briefing.heading: Tasking
briefing.text: Sabotage. Destroy the two uplink masts and get out.

special_rules.title: Droids at night
special_rules.text: The B1s start Unaware, busy at the masts: only turrets and drones start Alerted (chapter 10). Night limits sight to 12", for them as for the clones.

special_rules.title: The tactical droid
special_rules.text: If a contact turns out to be the tactical droid and its escort, every Separatist element within 12" of it, in its sight, uses the Tactical profile (Battle computer). Put it down first.

mission.title: Foundry Moon 2A: Kraken's Convoy
mission.situation: With the grid down, a gunship spotted Kraken's convoy halted on the mesa above the spire flats: its AAT has thrown a repulsor, and the super tactical droid is at the old relay post, re-routing the moon's droids by hand. Kraken runs the foundry's defence. Its memory core holds the codes of the ship that carries the foundry's output.

mission.task: Kraken is the HVT. A droid cannot be taken prisoner: put Kraken Down, or destroy it, then a model in base contact pulls its memory core with an Interact. The core travels with the model that took it, as data (chapter 13, seize); if that model goes Down, a model in base contact may take it with an Interact. Extract it by the Republic's edge.
mission.lockdown: Kraken runs: from now on it activates first each enemy turn, using the Handler profile's escape line toward the enemy's exit (the north-west corner). If it leaves the board, it has escaped. It also runs once the alert track reaches 4 (see Special rules).

mission.title: Foundry Moon 2B: Bring Them Home
mission.situation: The grid stayed up. It caught the gunship bringing the second wave over the spire flats; the gunship came down hard, and droids have dragged its pilot to the relay post on the mesa for a tactical droid to question. The rest of the crew are dead or scattered. Get the pilot back before the droids move them to the foundry.

mission.title: Foundry Moon 3: The Foundry Ship
mission.situation: The foundry's output is loading aboard the frigate Iron Covenant on the landing field: a battalion of droids, racked and powered down. Board the frigate's command deck, destroy the bridge and engineering so it never lifts, and get out. General Grievous is aboard to see the shipment off.

briefing.heading: Tasking
briefing.text: Sabotage. Destroy the bridge and engineering, and get out.

briefing.heading: Situation
briefing.text: The foundry's output is loading aboard the frigate Iron Covenant on the landing field: a battalion of droids, racked and powered down. Board the frigate's command deck, destroy the bridge and engineering so it never lifts, and get out. General Grievous is aboard to see the shipment off.

briefing.heading: Objective
briefing.text: The bridge (C1) and engineering (C2). A model in base contact sets a charge with an Interact (models without breaching charges use the room's own systems: same Interact). The target is destroyed at the end of that round (Very loud), unless an enemy model is in base contact with it then, which disarms the charge.

briefing.heading: Opposition
briefing.text: Separatist Alliance, threat tier 3. Guard (known): B1 battle droid section (4 models), on the bridge, Unaware. Contacts (unknown): 4 chips. Reinforcements: General Grievous and two MagnaGuards.

briefing.heading: Ground
briefing.text: The frigate's command deck (corvette layout, deck 8). Hazard: every outer wall is hull: a breaching charge or frag that damages it causes decompression (chapter 8). The droids are sealed; clones in clone armour are too.

briefing.heading: Complication
briefing.text: Early warning: the alert track starts at 1 (2 if Kraken escaped in 2A, or the pilot was lost in 2B).

briefing.text: Out by the airlock (P1). Enemy entry and exit: P3. Second enemy exit: secondary airlock (S2). Small mission: 20 minutes, clock die d4. Check-ins every 5 minutes from minute 10.

briefing.heading: Force

special_rules.title: From mission 2

special_rules.title: General Grievous
special_rules.text: At alert 4, Grievous and two MagnaGuards arrive at the enemy entry (P3), Alerted, Aggressive. Grievous is a Leader: his MagnaGuards fight with the Elite drill anyway.

special_rules.title: Grievous withdraws
special_rules.text: When Grievous is Wounded, or has 2 or more Suppression, he uses the Handler profile's escape line from then on, toward the nearest enemy exit (P3 or S2). If he leaves the board, he escapes to fight another day.

special_rules.title: The racked droids
special_rules.text: The droids in the holds are powered down and play no part, unless the alert track reaches 6: then the lockdown also places one B1 battle droid section at the enemy entry, Alerted.

results.text: The foundry's shipment never leaves Ordo Kessa, and the moon's droid army is blind and leaderless. The company is mentioned in dispatches.
The shipment is delayed by weeks, at a price. The foundry will have to be finished by a bigger force.
The battalion reaches the front. Ordo Kessa keeps building, and the Separatists know the Republic is watching.

campaigns.name: Outer Reach Patrol
campaigns.summary: Freespace Solutions is stripping wrecks and stations along the Outer Reach for a patron it won't name. Task Force Boone's boarding element and its ship, the Lantern, are to find the network, break it node by node, and build the case against whoever pays for it.

attacks.text: Freespace has found the Lantern's anchorage. The ship is boarded at the start of the second arc.

end.when: Evidence 6 before the third arc ends
end.text: The patron is exposed. Command takes the case to the Authority.
The network is broken, but its patron walks away.

end.when: Standing 0, or fewer than two arcs won
end.text: The Lantern is recalled. Freespace keeps working the Reach.
